common.appTagline: A private, compassionate space for your academic wellbeing.

crisis.title: Immediate Support & Emergency Resources
crisis.subtitle: Free, confidential help is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. You are not alone.
crisis.demoWarning: Demo Placeholders: The contact details shown below are for evaluation and must be institutionally verified prior to live campus deployment. Not verified for live crisis dispatch.
crisis.breathingInstruction: Inhale slowly for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 6 seconds.
crisis.confidentialityNote: Privacy Guarantee: Accessing this crisis page is completely private. No activity or IP records are linked to your university account or academic transcript.

landing.heroSubtitle: Sahayak helps you track personal stress patterns, reflect safely, and access verified support—without diagnosis, clinical labels, or privacy trade-offs.
landing.ctaExplorePrivacy: See How Your Data is Protected
landing.promiseNoDiagnosisDesc: We detect patterns to suggest gentle check-ins, never psychiatric diagnoses or medical labels.
landing.promiseConsentDesc: You choose what data is used. Revoke anytime with instant data scrubbing and full export.
landing.promiseHumanDesc: The system suggests, human counselors decide. No automated punitive actions, ever.
landing.roleStudentDesc: Private weekly pulse checks, personal baseline insights, and an encrypted reflection journal.
landing.roleCounselorDesc: Prioritized queue of consented check-in suggestions with plain-language context.
landing.roleAdminDesc: Macro wellness trends protected by k-anonymity (k >= 10). Zero individual tracking.

tiers.tier0Desc: Signals are within personal baseline variance.
tiers.tier1Desc: Mild single-vector drift observed. Self-care suggested.
tiers.tier3Desc: Significant sustained elevation or acute self-report requiring review.
